title: pose_frame
description: One set of body poses from a motion source (OptiTrack sender, simulator, mouse source) on Socket.IO namespace /ingest, event 'pose_frame'. Pose only: no velocities, no audio, no source tag. The hub derives the motion fields from successive pose_frames and emits one frame (frame.schema.json) per valid pose_frame. A source that tracks nothing at the moment sends empty bodies (the mouse source does so once on button release).

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject any other value.

source_time_s.description: Capture time on the source's own clock, seconds: monotonic, arbitrary epoch per source (OptiTrack: mocap frame time; mouse: performance.now() / 1000; simulator: scenario time). The hub uses it, not receipt time, as the clock for velocities. Going backwards resets every role's motion state.

bodies.description: Tracked bodies keyed by role (frame.schema.json#/$defs/role), so each role occurs at most once. A missing role means that body is not tracked in this frame. May be empty.

poseBody.description: Pose of one body: exactly the pose fields of frame.schema.json#/$defs/poseFields, nothing more.
